summary.text: Holly Eaton is a Democratic member of the Maine House of Representatives for District 15 and is a candidate for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Eaton has represented District 15 since 2022 and lives in Deer Isle.

paragraphs.text: Holly Eaton lives in Deer Isle, Maine, and earned a B.A. in English language and literature from Regis College in 1999.
Her career experience includes working as director of communications at The New England Institute for Teacher Education and as a community coordinator with Penobscot East Resource Center.
Eaton won District 15 in 2022, succeeding Margaret O'Neil, and won re-election in 2024, defeating Jason Joyce both times.
Ballotpedia lists her 2023-2024 committee assignment as the Marine Resources Committee.
In the 2026 general election she faces Clifford Noyes, an Unenrolled candidate.
